today.title: Today
today.lead: Your tests and sessions for today, in order.
today.emptyBody: When someone books a test or a session for today, it shows up here with the time, the athlete and what to prepare.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.lead: Every booking, upcoming and past, and the hours you can be booked.
bookings.emptyBody: Bookings from the website land here. You'll be able to set your hours, and move or cancel a booking from this page.

requests.title: Requests
requests.lead: Questions and requests sent through the contact form.
requests.emptyBody: When someone writes through the contact form, their message waits here until you answer it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: How your coach area works for you.
settings.emptyBody: Calendar sync and your other preferences will be set up here.

myBookings.title: My bookings
myBookings.lead: Your lab tests and coaching sessions.
myBookings.emptyBody: Once you book a lab test or a session, you'll find the date, the place and how to prepare here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: Your name, email and the language we write to you in.
profile.emptyTitle: Your profile is on its way
profile.emptyBody: Soon you'll be able to change your name and language here. Until then, write to us if something needs changing.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What you've agreed to, and your data.
privacy.emptyTitle: Your privacy settings are on their way
privacy.emptyBody: Soon you'll be able to change your consents, download your data or delete your account here. Until then, write to us and we'll do it for you.
